applies_to.quote: All Category – I Authorised Dealer Banks
AD Category – I banks may bring the contents of this circular to the notice of their exporter constituents

answer.action: Authorised dealer banks must inform their exporter constituents about the Exim Bank Line of Credit and follow remittance and declaration rules.
answer.action_quote: AD Category – I banks may bring the contents of this circular to the notice of their exporter constituents and advise them to obtain complete details

effective_date.quote: The Agreement under the LoC is effective from August 27, 2026.
